name: Blue Note / cut-paper cinema
rationale: Original Indigo Screening Room interpretation of the Blue Note saved pin's indigo paper, warm starburst and pasted hierarchy in the verified 2026-09-27 snapshot. Pinterest was inaccessible on 2026-10-26, so no new observation is claimed. Midnight blue surfaces and warm gold details frame compact ticket navigation, a split hero with a vertical metric rail, numbered horizontal roadmap chapters, paired resource cards, three-column film shelves and an upright serif-accented logbook. Existing licensed fonts and original CSS/SVG only; palette-driven scrollbars and private film-poster palettes are preserved. No reference artwork or logos copied.
